title: How strong must a harness be?
lines: In Europe and China a harness must hold fifteen kilonewtons, about one and a half tonnes.
The American standard asks more of the webbing: twenty-two kilonewtons when new.
But the force on the body is limited in all of them to about six hundred kilos.
Israel accepts gear certified to European, American or international standards.
Questions about gear or work-at-height training? Talk to Tal.
